en.contact: Let’s talk: go to the contact page
en.a2: My name is Lucio Calocero Arcella.
en.a3:
Graphic Designer graduated from FADU, UBA, focused on branding, motion graphics, UX/UI, 3D design, art direction and storytelling.

I like to think of design as a whole: how it moves, how it’s used and how it feels.
en.a4:
I’ve been creating visual identities since 2020, along with animations, digital pieces and interfaces that combine aesthetics, clarity and functionality.

Today I do it at COCO Creativo, designing and animating product videos, explainers and UI animation for SaaS companies, using After Effects, Figma, Blender and Premiere Pro.
en.a5: I was a teaching assistant in the course “Design 2” (Gabriele chair) and in the elective “Design and Communication in Music”, led by Javier Veraldi.
en.a6:
I published a fanzine together with Baba de Perro Zines and Editoriales El Fuerte, key names in Buenos Aires’ independent publishing scene.

Always eager to learn new tools, collaborate and dive into interesting projects.
en.a7: Based in Buenos Aires and open to relocation.
